scope: actual retro worker or bounded experimental DMG interpreter, source/content rights asserted by operator

curriculum.later_runs: source-replay-grounded UCB priority; novelty, counterfactual disagreement, revisit uncertainty, replay cost
curriculum.rare_actions: use evidence of least-observed finite control
curriculum.convergence: 10 sequential runs without new coarse visual state AND Q-value motion above 1e-6; not universal proof of no further learnability
curriculum.boomerang: seeded reshuffled reparse intervals and historical reservoir

cross_core.report_diff: per-feature absolute sensor differences, exact frame digest agreements, measured reward deltas, per-core repeat stability

actual_neural_optimizer.algorithm: deterministic two hidden layer tanh MLP, minibatch AdamW
actual_neural_optimizer.objective: one-step source-measured numeric telemetry delta and reward
actual_neural_optimizer.features: all actual available observation channels and action one hot
actual_neural_optimizer.episode_holdout: SHA256-seeded trace-group disjoint holdout; no validation gradients or normalization leakage
actual_neural_optimizer.receipt_validation: reconstitute policy+evidence SHA256 report; verify every committed episode/trace/sequence and rights assertion
actual_neural_optimizer.requirement_for_success: independent local executable run on rights-cleared real ROMs and non-degenerate heldout improvement
imported_checkpoint_validation: exact finite two-layer weight matrix lengths

limitations: No new native core compiled or ABI-verified by this PR
No real ROM replay or profile/e2e completion proved
Original in-process DMG runtime remains experimental
Native libretro requires approved external binaries and sandbox
Source-rights assertion is not third-party independent legal clearance
No game-event semantic classifier, joystick skill mastery, audiovisual cinematic labels, realtime cross-platform debugger, production LLM weight update or capability promotion has been verified
Native audio savestate and model-based real-run comparisons still need actual approved libretro replay verification
Operator RAM hypotheses are only experimentally controlled numerical measurements, not independently established score/health/victory flags
Pure-Python neural candidate optimizer is CPU bounded and not a production multimodal/transformer weight pipeline

replay_temporal_audio.reason: Restoring libretro core state and video without preceding host audio changes subsequent 12 temporal audio/motion observations; exact rewind needs native audio history
replay_temporal_audio.checksum: nested SHA256 plus outer snapshot digest

model_based_planning.search: finite discounted beam search over controller action sequences; speculative
model_based_planning.source_confirmation: compare each neural proposal to matched neutral exact-state baseline using actual emulator, repeated runs

operator_defined_goal_experiments.operator_hypotheses: explicit rights/source authority, numeric little-endian 1/2/4 byte offset, threshold or bitmask, no semantic auto labels
operator_defined_goal_experiments.neutral_baseline: same source snapshot and full neutral horizon as active action padded to equal length

native_first_boot_gate.source: operator-approved installed native libretro core + exact lawful ROM SHA256
sequence: approve exact installed native core and lawful ROM hash
reset and capture actual native framebuffer
step idle and serialize native core plus host temporal audio
step button a then serialize native state
restore idle savestate, replay a and compare observation/reward and native transition SHA
compare exact after-replay savestate including bound raw audio history
per-core source failure does not become success
native_first_boot_gate.failure_policy: all cores must independently pass; any failed case yields exit status 2 and failed receipt

original_rom_end_to_end_acceptance.scope: original locally generated Game Boy ROM CPU emulator only, no external native core
original_rom_end_to_end_acceptance.source: build_original_dmg_game exact original bytes and SHA256
stages: experimental LR35902 interpreter boot and true steps
bounded real AdamW numeric gradient updates
original_rom_end_to_end_acceptance.proof: Only after source Q and neural measurements validate; nonzero exit when heldout gain not shown

original_source_grounded_game_goal.game: generated original deterministic Game Boy maze only
original_source_grounded_game_goal.source_grounding: CPU writes VRAM maze, actual CPU-read positions/score/completion under controller actions, exact independent rewind/replay
original_source_grounded_game_goal.baseline: Same starting savestate and equal number of idle emulated frames
original_source_grounded_game_goal.learning: separate tabular Q-policy offline trained on actually measured tile movement/one-time completion gain
